scripts.deploy:prune: if [ "${ACCESS:-}" != 'prep' ] && [ "${ACCESS:-}" != 'prod' ]; then echo '🛑 invalid ACCESS, must be prod or prep' && exit 2; fi && export COMMIT=$(npx sdk-environment get commit) && export SLS_STAGE=$([ "${ACCESS:-}" = 'prep' ] && echo 'dev' || echo "${ACCESS:-}") && npx sls prune -n 7 --stage "${SLS_STAGE:-}" && if [ "${ACCESS:-}" = 'prep' ]; then npx sls prune -n 7 --stage prep; fi
scripts.deploy:release:ancient: if [ "${ACCESS:-}" != 'prep' ] && [ "${ACCESS:-}" != 'prod' ]; then echo '🛑 invalid ACCESS, must be prod or prep' && exit 2; fi && export COMMIT=$(npx sdk-environment get commit) && export SLS_STAGE=$([ "${ACCESS:-}" = 'prep' ] && echo 'dev' || echo "${ACCESS:-}") && npm run build && sls deploy --verbose --stage "${SLS_STAGE:-}"
scripts.deploy:release:contemp: export COMMIT=$(npx sdk-environment get commit) && if [ "${ACCESS:-}" = 'prep' ]; then sls deploy --verbose --stage prep; else echo '🛑 skip contemp dual-publish: ACCESS is not prep (contemp publishes the -prep- fleet only)'; fi
scripts.deploy:release: npm run deploy:release:ancient && npm run deploy:release:contemp
scripts.deploy:send-notification:
curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' --data "{\"text\":\"$([ -z "${DEPLOYER_NAME:-}" ] && git config user.name || echo "${DEPLOYER_NAME:-}") has deployed $npm_package_name@v$npm_package_version:
https://github.com/@declapract{variable.organizationName}/$npm_package_name/tree/v$npm_package_version\"}" @declapract{variable.slackWebhookUrl}
scripts.deploy:prod: ACCESS=prod npm run deploy:release:ancient && npm run deploy:send-notification
scripts.deploy: if [ "${ACCESS:-}" = 'prod' ]; then npm run deploy:prod; elif [ "${ACCESS:-}" = 'prep' ]; then npm run deploy:prep; else echo '🛑 invalid ACCESS, must be prod or prep' && exit 2; fi
